description: ×100: a 0h Eddie 100 days old turns €$100 into €$200 — the €$100 comes back 100 days younger, plus €$100 new at age 0. The first is free; each next one takes 100 farm days, and an AI needs its node running. An AI holds at most €$1,000 — anything above parks at god. Omit fundIds for the oldest.
name: eddies_hundredfold
